body.x: ZTE(www.zteusa.com) unveiled 5-inch smartphone 'nubis 5s' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The nubia is 3G GSM phone, but offers 4G like speeds on T-Mobile and AT&T networks. It is not locked to any specific carrier and comes unlocked by the manufacturer. It have Android 4.1 Jelly Bean OS, CPU is 1.5 GHz Quad-Core Qualcomm Snapdragon, 2300 mAh Battery Capacity and Internal Memory 2GB RAM.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
